title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Billing Guideline: Crediting the Final Billed Month after Withdrawal
content:
## Clauses

1. **Inputs.** For a withdrawn Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment, the charge considered is the enrollment's most recently posted tuition charge, and its billing month is the final billed month. The notice is the enrollment's most recent withdrawal notice request that is received or completed. It gives the requested last day, and its date of receipt is the notice date.
2. **Billing through the notice period.** The last day of care is still the requested last day. When the requested last day is earlier than the end of the notice period, tuition is still billed through the end of that notice period.
3. **Notice period.** The notice period is the program's withdrawal notice period, in calendar days counted from the day the notice was received as day 0.
4. **Billing end.** The billing end is the later of the requested last day and the last day of the notice period.
5. **Credit.** The amount the credit is figured on (the credit base) is the posted charge. The credit is the whole posted charge when the billing end falls before the first day of the charge's billing month, and nothing otherwise. It is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. A tuition charge already posted for a month that falls entirely after the billing end is still credited in full as a notice-period adjustment.
6. **Order.** The credit's parts work together in one order. The parts that set a date come first and fix the billing end. The part that turns a date into a share of the month then sets the share credited, the whole charge counting as 100 percent. That share is then taken of the amount the credit is figured on. The credit is rounded once at the end and never exceeds the charge.

The program's withdrawal notice period is the figure shown in the plan figures for withdrawal notice.

## Worked cases (hypothetical notice period of 10 days, charge of 240.00)

| Notice received | Requested last day | Last day of notice period | Billing end | Final billed month | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| October 20 | October 24 | October 30 | October 30 | November | 240.00, the whole charge (billing end before November 1) |
| October 20 | October 24 | October 30 | October 30 | October | nothing |
| October 20 | November 3 | October 30 | November 3 | November | nothing (billing end falls in November) |
